notes_for_editor: Name clash: Wahoo (Squaw) Peak (Nez Perce NF, built 1934, destroyed 1940s, 46.16470 -114.64692 in the FFLA listing) is a different lookout from Squaw Peak (Bitterroot NF, 45.52967 -114.60491). The 1941/1967 dates rest on Kresek as cited by Rex's page and Firelookout.com. Kresek's book (Fire Lookouts of the Northwest) is named in the Forest Service list as its source. No source describes the site today. The Spokane Historical photo has no image URL in our cache, so no photos entry. Brief record is consistent with sources.
